verdict.rationale: Evidence pack shows integrations with calendars, task tools (Todoist, Asana, ClickUp, Linear, Jira, Google Tasks) and an MCP endpoint, but no mention of Salesforce, HubSpot, Zapier, or any CRM/automation-stack sync for bookings. This is a fair capability question for a scheduling/booking product, but the pack contains no evidence Reclaim delivers it.
